threads.body: [Testing] This maintenance branch still runs `vaadin14LatestTest` through the Selenium/webpack path in `AbstractVaadinTest`; the browserless prerequisite from #21023 is absent. Removing the Node 22 pin exposes that suite to the `http_parser` incompatibility documented in the deleted comment when the runner supplies Node 24. Retain the Node 22 setup until the browserless changes are also backported.

replies.body: Backported the browserless prerequisite from #21023 in 22bbd15e0e820542aee168196a9467706ace40bd. The legacy Vaadin 14 suites now exercise real Flow routing and RPC in production mode without Selenium or webpack. Selenium remains scoped to the modern Vaadin suite, so removing the Node 22 setup no longer exposes the legacy tests to frontend compilation.

Backport that supported arrangement, including the source PR's suite changes, so Node removal is actually safe. Do not merely restore the pin, disable tests to hide failures, upgrade Node or gh-aw, change Renovate configuration, or make unrelated production changes.

Run the narrowest relevant formatter and behavior validation, covering default and latest-dependency suite selection. Exercise legacy browserless behavior without relying on preinstalled Node 22 or pnpm; report genuine environment limitations accurately. Acceptance criteria: the same PR continues targeting maintenance/v2.x and remains in its current ready-for-review state; the prerequisite from #21023 is present and legacy Vaadin tests no longer invoke Selenium/webpack; modern browser integration coverage remains; the original Node/pnpm CI cleanup remains; tests, fixtures and task wiring are consistent. Do not reply to or resolve review threads, create another requested PR, or change unrelated branches.

threads.body: [Testing] Every Vaadin test task still forces `otel.instrumentation.common.controller-telemetry.enabled=true` in `javaagent/build.gradle.kts:91`. Consequently, the new controller-disabled assertions in both the HTTP and Selenium suites never run in CI, leaving the default behavior unchecked. Run the normal suites with the flag off and retain controller-enabled coverage in separately wired test variants.

replies.body: Keeping the maintenance branch's existing controller-enabled test selection for this backport. This PR changes the test transport and frontend setup, not controller-telemetry configuration, defaults, or instrumentation behavior. The source fixtures also handle disabled telemetry, but adding a new mode matrix is a separate coverage improvement; it is not needed to preserve the routing/RPC coverage exercised by the existing suites.
